normalized_result.behavior: Mean, SD, CV and geometric mean come from a 4096-channel histogram on the parameter's scale: mean = sum of count x channel value / n (single precision); SD = sqrt(sum of count x (channel value - mean)^2 / (n - 1)); CV = 100 x SD / mean, not absolute; geometric mean on a linear axis = 10^(sum over channels >= 1 of count x log10(channel) / n), converted back.
